title: Claim tasks with atomic rename
description: This protocol moves a task through inbox, claimed, and done while recording each action.

steps.description: The code creates separate inbox, claimed, and done folders. STALE_AFTER sets the time a claim may sit without a write.
claim moves the task from inbox to claimed with os.rename. On one disk, that move is atomic, so one caller wins.

steps.question: After agent A claims task-7.md, can agent B claim the same inbox file?
steps.answer: No. A's rename moves the file first, so B gets FileNotFoundError and claim returns False.

steps.description: Agent A calls claim for task-7.md.
note appends a progress note. last_write uses the newer of the claim time and notes-file modification time as the sign of life.
take_if_stale waits while the holder is working or the most recent write is fresh. It replaces the claim only after the claim is stale.
Agent A writes a note, so agent B's early takeover waits.
finish moves the task into done, moves any notes, writes the result file, and logs the finish action.
After both recorded writes are moved back beyond STALE_AFTER, agent B can take the stale claim and finish it. The final folders place the task, notes, and result in done.
